title: Unit's First Groove
logline: A shy robot named Unit overcomes their social anxiety to find joy and connection on a vibrant rooftop dance floor.
theme: Overcoming shyness, the power of encouragement, finding your own rhythm.

characters.name: Unit
characters.one_line_description: A small, somewhat boxy robot with expressive optical sensors, initially very shy and hesitant.

characters.name: Spark
characters.one_line_description: A sleek, energetic robot with flashing lights, friendly and encouraging, a natural dancer.

characters.name: Party-Goers
characters.one_line_description: A diverse group of robots of all shapes and sizes, enjoying the party and dancing.

scenes.title: The Edge of the Party
scenes.summary: Unit stands awkwardly at the edge of a bustling rooftop party, watching other robots dance with longing and apprehension.
scenes.setting: A vibrant rooftop party at dusk, neon lights, upbeat electronic music.

scenes.title: An Invitation to Dance
scenes.summary: Spark, noticing Unit's shyness, approaches with a friendly gesture and encourages them to join the dance floor.
scenes.setting: Still at the edge of the rooftop party, closer to the main dance area.

scenes.title: First Hesitant Steps
scenes.summary: Spark gently guides Unit through some simple dance moves, Unit is stiff and self-conscious, but tries.
scenes.setting: A slightly less crowded spot on the dance floor.

scenes.title: Finding the Rhythm
scenes.summary: Unit starts to loosen up, their movements becoming more fluid and unique, finding their own charming, robotic style. Other Party-Goers notice and smile.
scenes.setting: The center of the dance floor, more energetic.

scenes.title: Dancing Freely
scenes.summary: Unit is now fully immersed, dancing with unbridled joy, surrounded by appreciative Party-Goers. Spark claps enthusiastically.
scenes.setting: The peak of the rooftop party, glowing with energy.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
